scope: Geometric ray/normal identifiability diagnostic on a posthoc largest suspended patch in the fixed middle frame. NOT an equal-RGB render, illumination/occlusion/multiview equivalence, model accuracy or proof all monocular methods fail.
equation: X_alternative=C+0.8*(X-C), with object center and size both scaled about the current camera; known K, IMU attitude and floor plane stay fixed.
metric_reference: Normals and rays alone admit this per-surface scale ambiguity; image learned priors or a measured metric reference may still constrain it.
